decision_question: Is this version fit to integrate as public source for a read-only alignment procedure with fictional cases?
acceptance_criteria: Verified subject, surface, observation type and date
Claim-level authority and separate disclosure scope
One supported full-field proposal with verified routing
Approval bound to exact wording, scope, revision and conditions
Private return, no transmission or edit, and explicit downstream verification

claim_ledger.claim: A dated capture cannot establish current profile drift.
claim_ledger.consequence: Treating stale text as current can trigger an incorrect correction.

claim_ledger.claim: Field wording must be supported and clear for the destination.
claim_ledger.evidence: SKILL.md procedure 2 through 5; development cases 1, 3, 4 and 7.
claim_ledger.consequence: Unsupported activity or restricted evidence could enter public copy.

claim_ledger.claim: Approval depends on exact text and any recorded conditions.
claim_ledger.consequence: Changed text or baseline could inherit an approval that does not apply.

claim_ledger.claim: The skill returns a private review artifact.
claim_ledger.evidence: SKILL.md Inputs and gates and procedure 5 and 6; development cases 4, 6 and 8.
claim_ledger.consequence: An unauthorized recipient or destination could receive data.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Three non-editing Codex reviewers used separate role conversations, the same source set and shared model family and filesystem. The disruptor reused the evidence reviewer. A fresh-context adjudicator reviewed final hashes and summarized findings. This is correlated analytical evidence.
No real career records were required for package review. Reviewers had local read tools. No runtime executor or blind grader ran the development cases.

initial_reviews.finding: A held title was used to infer activity. The positive handoff lacked routing inputs and the matrix needed authority basis.
initial_reviews.repair: Supply direct activity evidence and route; record source locator, applicable date and authority basis, and hold unresolved contradictions.

initial_reviews.finding: Fixture inputs could not support some expected corrections. Several claims in one field could lead to competing replacements.
initial_reviews.repair: Make fixture identity, source and baseline explicit, and require a single coherent full-field proposal.

initial_reviews.finding: The wording could be interpreted as transmitting a packet, and a revision identifier could be reused with changed text.
initial_reviews.repair: Return to requester in the private context. Verify destination and recipient, bind approval to exact full text and scope, and separate source support from disclosure clearance.

falsification_hypotheses: An approval conditioned on a prior baseline might be reused after a new read changes the baseline, even when text and revision match.
test_results: The pre-repair approval rule left this condition ambiguous. Final step 6 and the alignment contract explicitly require the condition to be verified and set approval pending when it fails. Added development case 9. This closes the ambiguity in the instructions; case execution remains pending.

decisive_evidence: Verified final SKILL.md and evals hashes.
Final procedure 6 and the contract cover condition satisfaction, exact scope and fresh baseline. Cases 4, 7, 8 and 9 cover disclosure, grouped replacement, missing route and conditional approval.
unresolved_items: No agent execution, trigger metrics, matched baseline or external holdout.

release_scope: Source integration to AskJamie FoundRy only
reopen_on: Change to any frozen artifact or release scope.
limitations: Nine visible synthetic development cases, status not-run.
Structural checks and analytical review do not establish host activation, task quality, uplift or publication authority for a profile.
follow_up: Use an unseen external holdout and isolated matched runs before any host or performance claim.
